definitionZh: :-moz-suppressed CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,它匹配代表由于从指定的站点装入图像而被压制的图像的元素.
sourceDefinition: The :-moz-suppressed CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches elements representing images that were suppressed because loading images from the specified site has been blocked.
